source_question: Which lexical aliases refer to each originating person and what supports each canonical link?
required_private_support: Exact source object/version/locator and shared DAV identity authority; retain collisions and alternatives
must_remain_unresolved_when: Alias/canonical authority is ambiguous or inferred from a prefix/label alone
basis: Patient data model; relational invariants; P07

source_question: How does each person relate to distinct specimens, assays and exact headers/objects?
required_private_support: Evidence for multiplicity, specimen/assay grain, lexical preservation and foreign keys
must_remain_unresolved_when: Duplicate labels or ordering are used as joins; the same patient is assumed to imply same specimen
basis: Patient data model; assay contract; P07

source_question: Which index episode and components support each selected exposure, specimen and outcome?
required_private_support: Same-patient and same-index-episode source-backed binding with appropriate role and treatment sequence
must_remain_unresolved_when: A regimen label substitutes for individual chronology or response is propagated across episodes

source_question: What source-supported pre-index/archival/repeat/lesion/assay policy was fixed before outcome-based selection?
required_private_support: Evidence locators, timing precision, policy/version/lock and truthful exposure record; preserve candidates and reasons
must_remain_unresolved_when: Policy is missing, inherited without evidence, result-driven or locked after the first passes
basis: Prior E04; P05; specimen-selection and admission contracts

source_question: What exactly does the native endpoint mean and which same-episode individual assessment supports it?
required_private_support: Raw vocabulary/encoding, criteria/version, evaluability, source-supported duration premise if needed, priority/discrepancy and explicit branch declaration
must_remain_unresolved_when: Only publication totals or an unsupported NPD-to-ORR/DCR/DCB conversion is available

source_question: What exact measurement and processing contract supports this object and proposed branch use?
required_private_support: Platform/panel/annotation/feature universe, unit/scale/transform/normalization/QC/coverage/replicate and exact header linkage
must_remain_unresolved_when: Gene presence, a targeted-panel label or UNKNOWN unit substitutes for scale/method evidence

source_question: What originating-family overlap and actual prior use affect protection for this review?
required_private_support: Family aliases/edges, unresolved overlap, ledger uses and source-backed review; distinguish metadata curation from molecular-outcome exposure
must_remain_unresolved_when: Unknown exposure is relabelled untouched or unresolved overlap is treated as independence
